subject: Order Form: commercial exceptions & tax routing — legal handoff
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@novavista.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novavista.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form draft (NV-001842)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the draft. Legal here flagged a couple of items before we can route the PO:

- Net terms: procurement prefers Net45 for first invoice, then Net30 thereafter. Is Redwood able to accept Net45 on first invoice?
- Minimum commit: your Appendix B shows a 12-month minimum at 250k. We need either a 6-month ramp or a reduction to 200k — can you confirm flexibility?
- Tax/residency: our tax team asked for explicit language saying Novavista is responsible for local VAT/GST and Redwood will gross-up only where required by law. For EU sales, we may need reverse-charge language.
- Invoicing remit: please confirm the customer-facing remit address and whether invoices will come from Redwood Inference Inc. (US) or a UK/EU entity. Our AP requires an invoice stub showing the remit entity and a PO number line.

Attached: Novavista_OrderForm_v3.pdf (with our suggested highlight comments). Please loop in accounting/legal on your side and let us know if these are deal-breakers. We have a target signature cadence this week.

Thanks,
Samantha Wu
Senior Procurement Manager | Novavista Health
samantha.wu@novavista.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--- Original attachment: Novavista_OrderForm_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@novavista.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form draft (NV-001842)

Samantha — thanks for the clear notes and for attaching the highlighted PDF. Quick responses inline: 

- Net terms: We can accept Net45 on the first invoice as a one-time concession for this onboarding (we typically list Net30). We'll call this out in the Order Form as "Net30, first invoice Net45 (customer-request)."

- Minimum commit: We are willing to split the first 12 months into a 6/6 ramp: first 6 months at 60% of the annual commit, months 7–12 at remaining 40%. That effectively reduces near-term exposure and preserves the full-year commit you asked for. If you prefer a flat 200k total instead, that would require a pricing uplift of 6% — we can put both options in the Appendix and you can choose.

- Tax: For US invoicing, Redwood Inference Inc. (US) will issue invoices. For EU customers we have an EU entity option; for Novavista we understand primary operations are US-based, so vendor will bill from Redwood Inference Inc. Per your ask, we'll add language: "Customer responsible for VAT/GST; where law requires withholding, the Parties will gross-up as appropriate." For the EU reverse-charge, we'll add a conditional clause in Exhibit A and leave a checkbox for legal to confirm.

- Invoicing remit: Please instruct procurement to include PO referencing deal id NV-001842 and remit to: Redwood Inference Inc., 2100 Market St., Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94114. We'll add invoice contact accounting@redwood.com and an invoice stub example.

I've attached a short redline summary (Redline_Comparison_Notes.xlsx) highlighting the exact language edits we propose. Next steps: Kar­t­hik — can you confirm the remit entity and whether we need to route any invoices through an EU VAT entity? Ben — I'd like your sign-off on the ramp option vs flat 200k (plus the discretionary 6% uplift option). Marissa — can legal prioritize a quick review of the Exhibit A tax clause?

If these are acceptable, I'll hand to legal and send to Novavista Legal for final review + DocuSign.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0112

Attachment: Redline_Comparison_Notes.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form draft (NV-001842)

Kim / Ben — quick accounting confirmation:

1) Remit entity: Redwood Inference Inc. (US) is fine for Novavista; no EU invoicing entity required based on the customer's primary billing location.
2) PO line: Please ensure the example invoice includes a single-line PO reference and the customer wiring instructions we shared earlier. Our AR team needs: PO number, remit entity, invoice contact (accounting@redwood.com), and a clear description matching the Order Form SKU and period.
3) Net terms acceptance: AR will allow first invoice Net45; ongoing Net30 acceptable. Need flag in the billing notes so collections apply default aging after that.
4) Minimum commit: If we move to the 6/6 ramp, accounting prefers the 60%/40% split on revenue recognition. If Novavista opts for the 200k flat, we need to apply the +6% pricing uplift and update ARR forecast.

I've attached Accounting_Evidence.csv with the required stub format for their AP team. Once legal finalizes the Exhibit A language, we can generate the final invoice template and send via DocuSign.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: Accounting_Evidence.csv (csv)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@novavista.com>, Novavista Legal <contracts@novavista.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Order form draft (NV-001842) — ready for legal review / DocuSign prep

Samantha / Novavista Legal — attaching our redline summary and the accounting stub that Kar­t­hik provided. Per the internal handoff:

- Net terms: We will list Net30 with a one-time first invoice Net45 concession.
- Minimum commit: We propose the 6/6 ramping option as the primary path (first 6 months at 60% of annual commit). If you prefer the 200k flat option, we will apply a 6% price uplift.
- Tax: Draft language added — "Customer responsible for VAT/GST; where local withholding applies, Customer will remit gross amounts and Redwood will gross-up net receipts where required by law. For EU supplies, the Parties agree to use reverse-charge language where applicable to the supply." Please review the Exhibit A checkbox for reverse-charge applicability.
- Invoicing remit: Invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference Inc. Please include PO referencing NV-001842 on the invoice. Our AR contact is accounting@redwood.com.

Ben — I need your quick approval to proceed with the 6/6 ramp as standard; authorize up to a 6% pricing uplift if customer insists on 200k flat. Marissa — can Legal review Exhibit A tax language and confirm we can send the updated Order Form to Novavista Legal by EOD Friday?

If all good, I'll upload the final doc to Drive and kick off DocuSign (link below). Samantha, if you want a catch-up call to walk the legal team through the redlines before signature, say the word and I'll set it up.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
